meta.sample: Adults aged 20-59 who answered the NHANES marijuana question (DUQ200), MEC-examined, NHANES 2005-2018 public files
meta.design: Weights WTMEC2YR/7 (pooled 2005-2018), strata SDMVSTRA, PSU SDMVPSU, Taylor linearization; design built on the full pooled sample and restricted with subset()
meta.model: Survey-weighted logistic regression (svyglm, quasibinomial); OR with t-based 95% CI on residual design df
meta.analytic_sample_rule: Complete cases on the exposure, the outcome and ALL covariates in every block, so each exposure/outcome/sample uses the same people across covariate sets
meta.flag_rule: 'imprecise' when exposed or unexposed cases < 10 or residual df < 8 (shown greyed, not interpreted)

blocks.alcohol: Alcohol (none / moderate / heavy in past year)

outcomes.cancer_excl_skin_cervical: Cancer excluding non-melanoma skin and cervical

exposures.x_regular: Regular use: monthly for ≥1 year (vs never)

samples.excl_after: Excluding cases who started using after diagnosis
samples.excl_after_same: Excluding cases who started after or in the same year as diagnosis
